en: You have gathered yourself back together. But the bell has not yet fallen silent.

en: The True One did not shatter into just one shard that is you. The fellow Daoists of the jianghu are shards too, and someone is still counting. A new shard unlocks when a life closes. Unlocked

en: The book is sealed with a golden thread. Collect all 10 shards of Volume I and reach the ending Ten Thousand Lives Become One to break the seal.
